summary: Bush-backed kerb on narrow Bryce Street, apartments about 20 m across the road.
reasons: Backs onto bush and park on the east
Narrow street; room beside lane unclear

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush and parkland on the kerb side; River Park View and other apartments sit 20-25 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; a few cars park on the west side, the east edge is tree-lined with little visible verge.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential side street off Sir Fred Schonell Drive.
drivers.convention: Some cars park along the street; signs are 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, no overnight convention.

flags: Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, Brisbane River 233 m away
Slope within limit here, steeper at the ends (max 10.6%)
Apartments within about 25 m across the road
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb, shade most of the day, more from the east.
cannot_judge: Room beside the lane on the east side

best_section.where: East kerb of Bryce Street opposite the small apartment blocks, between the side path and the bend
